Title: Community Garden Handbook

=========================
Community Garden Handbook
=========================

Watering
========

Water raised beds early in the morning so leaves dry before evening.
Tomatoes need deep watering twice a week rather than a little every day.

Compost
=======

Green waste such as vegetable peelings and grass clippings goes in the left bin.
Brown waste such as dry leaves and cardboard goes in the right bin.
Turn the compost every two weeks.

Tools
=====

Return shared tools to the shed and lock it with the combination posted inside the noticeboard.
